pools_and_water_areas.name: Atmosphere Pool
pools_and_water_areas.description: The main outdoor pool (25 m / 80 ft long), offering approximately 10 m² of open space per passenger. Features immersive night-time lighting and a massive LED poolside theater screen for movies and concerts.

pools_and_water_areas.name: Bamboo Pool
pools_and_water_areas.description: An indoor, glass-domed magrodome pool designed for all-weather swimming, accompanied by multi-level thalassotherapy hot tubs and lush tropical lounge seating.

pools_and_water_areas.name: Horizon Pool & Amphitheatre
pools_and_water_areas.description: A large open-air pool deck situated at the aft offering panoramic wake views. The sun lounging amphitheatre layout transforms into an outdoor dance floor and live stage at night.

pools_and_water_areas.name: MSC Yacht Club Pool & Solarium
pools_and_water_areas.description: Private, exclusive swimming pool and hot tub located on the Yacht Club Sundeck forward, reserved exclusively for MSC Yacht Club passengers.
pools_and_water_areas.access: Exclusive to MSC Yacht Club Guests

pools_and_water_areas.name: Jacuzzis / Whirlpool Network
pools_and_water_areas.description: Nine outdoor whirlpool tubs situated throughout the lido, aft amphitheatre, and private sundecks.
